# Idea Catalog

Central index of tracked ideas.

## Rules

- Each idea ID appears once.
- Status must be one of: `inbox`, `active`, `parked`, `killed`, `finalized`.
- Finalized ideas may include an optional summary export path.

## Registry

| Idea ID | Title | Status | Owner | Sessions | Summary Export | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| _none yet_ | _none yet_ | inbox | unassigned | _none_ | _n/a_ | Add rows as ideas are captured |
files.NOTES_CATALOG.md:
# Notes Catalog

Central index of saved research and context notes.

## Rules

- Note IDs must be unique and use format `note-####`.
- Note paths must point to files under `notes/`.
- Dates use `YYYY-MM-DD`.

## Registry

| Note ID | Title | Date | Related Idea | Source Context | Path | Tags |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
